description:
The wizard Elma Ruskan has a beloved lover and disciple, Muska. Facing his final exam at the Wizards' Association this year due to unstable magic, Muska proposes to Elma, offering to live together in another country after the exam. Elma hesitates, and Muska asks him to answer after the exam, heading to the capital. However, all he receives in return is his cold left arm. Muska dies mysteriously, and his body disintegrates into various magical artifacts, which are then scattered. Elma makes a pact with Malo in exchange for half of his soul and half of his internal organs, hoping to reclaim the body of his lover, who has become a magical artifact.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
